equity.level_reason: Age defines the population and the recommendation groups (≥75 vs 60–74 years). Rural residence appears only in the risk-factor Box, framed as access to escalated care, a recommendation-level descriptor.

level_alternative.reason: Rural residence is listed as one clinical-style risk criterion for vaccination, not a social-position framing; age alone gives level 0.

equity.equity_measurement: No SPD-specific results; the EtR framework lists equity implications, and Table 2 strata are age and chronic-condition groups from a cited model.

notes: All headline estimates are cited: manufacturer hazard-ratio efficacy, observational VE from four studies, an FDA self-controlled case series (adjusted IRR), VSD rapid cycle analysis, and a Monte Carlo benefit-risk model (ref 11). The pooled trial relative risks may be work-group computations (GRADE), which would make data_focus yes; they cite ref 4 and a supplementary table, so they are read as cited.
